items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 10:51pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 23 October 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales or severe gales tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

A deep low (Storm Austen) lies in the English Channel tracking eastwards, as a new rapidly deepening Atlantic low (Storm Boelo) tracks eastwards driving frontal troughs into the area by dawn tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 5 to 7, backing West or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight. Backing and Increasing South 7 to severe gale 9 through tomorrow morning and early afternoon, veering West or Southwest 7 or gale 8 late afternoon or early evening, gale 8 or severe gale 9 late evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough falling mainly moderate tonight, building rough or very rough tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain for a time tomorrow, clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9 tomorrow night, decreasing 7 or gale 8 Sunday afternoon, 6 or 7 in evening.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate or rough Sunday evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
